definition.en: The necessary modifications and adjustments in judicial and administrative proceedings so that persons with disabilities can take part in them on an equal basis, in any capacity (party, witness, victim, juror, etc.).

en: The CRPD requires them in art. 13 as a condition of access to justice: they include, for instance, accessible formats, plain language, interpreters, court facilitators, the adaptation of timeframes and spaces, or assistance with communication. Unlike reasonable accommodation, they are not subject to the disproportionate-burden limit: they can never be denied on grounds of cost or excessive effort. They must also be age- and gender-appropriate.

prefLabel.en: Rights, legal capacity and access to justice
